prompts.closed: Use case: precise-object-edit. This is a 1200x1200 four-cell production atlas of the SAME elderly illustrated character in four already approved drawings. Edit only eyelids for a CLOSED BLINK in all four cells. Keep the 2x2 cell boundaries and exact size/composition. In each cell erase the open iris, pupil, sclera and old open upper-lid line and replace with ONE natural closed eyelid on that eye's own position. Crucial: the thin round BRASS GLASSES, their bridge, both frames, their tilt and position must remain pixel-aligned to the supplied image; glasses DO NOT move with the eyelids. Top two cells are three-quarter profile: the eye above/behind each spectacle is closing, not the spectacle itself; keep perspective and wrinkles. Bottom left is surprised: eyebrows remain high, spectacles remain exactly where they are, only eyes shut. Bottom right is relieved: maintain its own tearful expression and spectacles. Do not change mouths, moustaches, noses, eyebrows, hair, skin hue, head scale, crop, background or alpha. No new line above the closed lash. Preserve the watercolor pencil texture. Output same four-cell atlas, genuine original transparency in top-row empty regions.
prompts.half: Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit the supplied 1200x1200 four-cell production atlas. All four drawings show the same elderly man in distinct approved poses/expressions. Create the INTERMEDIATE HALF-CLOSED BLINK: the upper eyelid has lowered about halfway over each iris, keeping a narrow visible iris and lower sclera, naturally and gently. Do NOT fully shut the eyes. Keep EXACT 2x2 grid, scale, crop and head poses. Both brass spectacles and bridge MUST remain in exactly the original position and curve; only the eye inside/behind the glass changes. Keep each cell's eyebrows, wrinkles, mouth, hair, moustache, nose, skin colors and background unchanged. For top row small profile drawings, preserve the eyes' perspective and glasses silhouette. Bottom left preserves surprised high eyebrows; bottom right preserves relieved moist eyes. No extra eye line, no moved glasses, no double pupils. Preserve the original transparent pixels in the top row. This is an animation inbetween, not a redesign.
prompts.mouths: Use case: precise-object-edit. Production mouth-cel atlas: preserve exact 1200x1200 2x2 grid, same elderly man, two profile poses repeated in two rows. Edit ONLY his mouth underneath the white moustache. TOP ROW: very slightly parted lips during soft speech, a narrow natural dark slit, no teeth and no red painted lips. BOTTOM ROW: a modest open speaking mouth, not wide surprise, a small dark wedge in the correct three-quarter perspective; minimal lower-lip ochre rim. Keep the two mouth corners anchored to the input, preserve the entire moustache and beard outline, allowing only a tiny separation of the moustache just above the aperture. No duplicate lip line and no lip floating on top of beard. Mouth must join face and hair naturally. Keep every other part unchanged: eyes, glasses, head pose, eyebrows, nose, hair, crop, proportions, lighting, clothes, transparency. Top left and bottom left must remain the first pose; right column stays the second pose. Use the original painterly pencil edge, avoid bright lipstick, smile or teeth. Genuine transparency as original.
